_note: Register fragment for publication-withdrawal-aftercare. REQ-PWA-002: the depublication says what the public tombstone of a withdrawn publication tells a reader: a public reason beside the internal one, and whether it names the title. REQ-PWA-001: a publicationVersion keeps the public projection and the public files of a publication as they were before a correction, so a cited version stays reachable; it carries no public read rule, the version routes check the publication first. REQ-PWA-003: the publication schema offers OpenRegister's archive and freeze, so a withdrawn publication is frozen with its reason, and the depublication records whether that freeze worked. The versions are the merged ones, so the last fragment in name order (woo-x-access-boundary-hardening.json) carries the same bumps.
